# go-modern-maps-clone

**Since:** Go 1.21

## Summary

Use maps.Clone instead of manual map iteration.

## Details

maps.Clone returns a shallow copy of a map using the standard helper.
It preserves nil maps and makes the copy operation explicit.

## Examples

### Before

```go
copied := make(map[string]int, len(src))
for k, v := range src {
  copied[k] = v
}
```

### After

```go
copied := maps.Clone(src)
```
